summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $5,058,329 in ordinary shares through sales agent D. Boral Capital LLC, pursuant to an Equity Distribution Agreement. The shares trade on Nasdaq under KWM (last price $0.0750 on July 30, 2026). The ATM is limited to one-third of public float per Form F-3 General Instruction I.B.5. D. Boral receives a 7.0% commission plus 1.0% for non-accountable expenses. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. No deal terms apply; what to watch is potential dilution from ongoing at-the-market sales.
